name: Runsite
description: European PaaS with automated deployments from GitHub for web services or static sites (1 web 0.1 vCPU/256 MB free), managed PostgreSQL and Valkey(Redis) (30 days for free), Transactional Email (3,000 emails/month free), S3 compatible storage (5 GB/free), all what you need for start your web site. Servers located in Germany.
